annotations.title: Turn an image into a video

description: Start an image to video job on OpenUncensored: the image becomes the first frame and the prompt says what happens in the clip. Returns the job (id, status, price). Clips take from about half a minute to a few minutes: call get_video with the id to check on it and to get the download link. Video model ids, lengths and prices are in list_models (e.g. minimax-h3-chili-image-to-video). The account is charged only when the clip completes; a failed clip costs nothing.

api_key.description: Defaults to the key in the MCP config.

image.description: The first frame: a public https URL, or a data URL such as data:image/png;base64,... (up to 20 MB).

model.description: Video model id from list_models, e.g. minimax-h3-chili-image-to-video

prompt.description: What happens in the clip. Up to 4000 characters.

resolution.description: Optional, one of the model's resolutions in list_models, e.g. 720p.

seconds.description: Clip length, one of the model's lengths in list_models. Default: the model's default.

name: create_video
title: Turn an image into a video
